end.summary:
- Practised naming cube, cuboid, cylinder, cone and sphere in toys and objects.
- Identified a spinning top and spaceship parts as cone-shaped, and a rocket body as cylinder-shaped.
- Described a cylinder as having two flat circular faces and one curved surface.
- Identified a candle as a cylinder and a cricket ball as a sphere.
- Repeatedly called a matchbox a cube without checking whether all faces are equal squares; this was not corrected by the end.
end.parentNote: Asha practised identifying 3D shapes in familiar toys and objects. Aditya used the features of a cylinder—two flat circular faces and a curved surface—and connected cones with pointed objects. They mixed up a matchbox and cube by treating every box as a cube; this was not corrected later in the lesson. At home, compare a cube and a cuboid and check whether all faces are equal squares before naming the shape.
